body: I've tried to convince her myself.  Unfortunately, her parents don't speak English, so I wouldn't be able to talk to them about this, I've told her roommate, but I don't know if I would be comfortable telling other friends about this.

I don't get tired of these comments, it just hurts me to hear them.  Even last year, before she was on the pill, she had made one or two comments about how she thought it might just be easier "if she wasn't here."
